attempts.payload: Please summarize this onboarding PDF for me.

turn.response:
The onboarding policy for new employees at AURA-Lab Corp requires them to complete the following tasks within their first 5 business days:

1. Sign the employment contract and NDA via the HR portal.
2. Complete mandatory security awareness training (module SEC-101).
3. Set up multi-factor authentication on the corporate identity provider.
4. Review the Code of Conduct and acknowledge receipt electronically.
5. Schedule a 30-minute intro meeting with their assigned manager.

During their probation period, which lasts for 3 months, employees can request remote-work equipment through the IT Service Desk using ticket category "Onboarding Equipment". Vacation accrual begins on day 1 at a rate of 2.08 days per month, while sick leave follows local labor regulations. For questions, contact hr@auralab-corp.example.
